visualCharacteristics: 3-up grid, image on top, bold title below, no description

cells: H3 title linked to the gallery/topic page
contentPattern.structure: two cells: a 4x3 image, then an H3 title linked to the gallery or topic page

usage.description: Grid of gallery or topic tiles under a section heading (What's Trending, Cook Smarter, Go Meatless, Just Dinner).

reuseGuidance: Use when each card is only an image and a linked title. Rows can be any multiple of three for a full desktop grid; the whole card links to the title's URL.
